verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own docs say it centralizes "stakeholder access" with permissions over who can view equity data. Support articles on setting shareholder equity value visibility and on creating and sharing messages suggest shareholders can log in to see holdings and receive company messages. All of this is thin: support-article titles and a marketing line, with no detailed description of the investor-facing view or the update workflow. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of an investor/shareholder portal showing holdings, evidence of structured investor updates (templated metrics or reports), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table

citations.quote: manage ownership, equity transactions, compliance, documents, and stakeholder access in one place
Advanced permissions give administrators control over who can view or modify sensitive equity data
